name: two ropes climb
description: Climb up using two ropes, pulling with your arms one hand over the other. It builds a strong pull and grip.
instructions: Grab one rope in each hand and hang with arms long.
Pull up with one arm while you bend your elbow close to your body.
Reach higher with the other hand and pull again.
Keep your core tight and your legs steady.
Climb to a safe height, then lower under control.
